title: War in the Crown of the Marches
changes: The Crown of the Marches joins the clan war: ten territories, and each of the five approaches starts with the clan whose Crownway leads into it.
The Crown Keep starts with the clan holding the least land and cannot be taken by sieges, raids or sacks: it changes hands only at a Reckoning, which is coming.
The war table now shows the Crown's territories, and routes lead through the Crownways to any of them.
